recent_en: ALSREIT completed the disposal of a property in Petaling Jaya, Selangor for RM10,000,000 cash on 28 October 2026. The company had earlier announced a second interim income distribution of 0.86 sen per unit for FY2026.

Announced a second interim income distribution of 0.86 sen per unit for FY2026.
